big: A social media page promises easy returns on global trading through an app nobody has heard of. Dadi's neighbour sent ₹2 lakh. The app showed a profit, then asked for more to release it. The money never came back.

lines: How do I know a global platform is genuine?
Use only a regulated channel, an authorised bank, broker or fund house. Be wary of apps promising easy global profits. Spread your money, and match your time horizon to the risk.
